mapper.select: SELECT ss.id, ss.doctor_id AS doctorId, ss.date, ss.time_slot AS timeSlot, ss.total_quantity AS totalQuantity, ss.remaining_quantity AS remainingQuantity, ss.status, CASE WHEN ss.remaining_quantity > 0 THEN 'available' ELSE 'full' END AS slotStatus FROM source_setting ss WHERE ss.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND ss.date = #{date} AND ss.status = 1 ORDER BY FIELD(ss.time_slot, '08:00-09:00','09:00-10:00','10:00-11:00', '11:00-12:00','14:00-15:00','15:00-16:00','16:00-17:00')
